An '''arm band''' was utilized by the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] leader [[Brejik]] during<ref name="kotor" /> [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> When used in conjuction with his [[Brejik's belt|belt]], it created an effective barrier against melee attacks.<ref name="kotor" /> [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] may have scavenged the arm band from Brejik's corpse after a [[lightfight]] with the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] against Revan and [[Bastila Shan]].
